scope: Independent static review of runner, preparation, shared identities and launcher. No runner or build execution.

confirmed_corrections.disposition: Retained validated job groups receive killpg even when ps fails or the guard has exited. Normal terminate and watchdog fallback both reach bound-group signalling; direct Popen handles remain fallback ownership.

Failure sets stopping under the terminal lock before receipt publication. Outer launch and child registration share that lock; ACK publication checks both latch and first failure under it. Worker reads first failure before each phase. A phase already crossing its check is stopped through group cleanup; the worker check alone is not an atomic cross-process launch barrier.
Failure receipt OSError sends TERM and KILL to bound groups and live direct children before propagating. Storage failure cannot establish a successful durable receipt.

Both implementations write and fsync a private exclusive temporary file, publish complete bytes using link for no-overwrite or replace otherwise, remove the temporary name and fsync the parent. Ownership and ACK cannot expose a partially written JSON destination.

Launcher calculates absolute UTC deadline before exec and uses Python -I -S -B. Bootstrap uses stdlib before self/payload hash verification and private-copy verification; helper import and guarded worker/checker paths use verified private payload. Worker and checker use -S -B. Launcher and README are now sealed payload inputs.

Exclusive first failure is retained, negative signal statuses normalized, and a shared locked exclusive terminal finalizer propagates the earliest recorded exit code. Nonzero build skips checker; no automatic retry loop.

Nonce, context hash, actual PID/PGID and lstart identity bind ownership before ACK permits build. Observed processes require matching birth identities; retained group ownership survives guard exit. Process identities and OS signalling remain static reasoning, not executed proof.

Absolute/escaping dependency symlinks are rejected; copied and original dependencies have full file/symlink identity checks. Every exported regular source input is hashed, including temporary config after its explicit delta. Pre/post comparison excludes only declared generated outputs and separately checked node_modules. Runtime and original/private payload hashes are checked again.

other_checks: Absolute deadline is fixed before guard start; no phase resets it. Policy requires maximum 180 seconds, final three seconds reserved, --wait 0, 850 MB guard, 450 MB heap, two workers and no minification.
Fresh output plus persistent exclusive seal claim rejects reuse; command output and events are synchronised, with separate phase, checker, process audit and terminal receipts.
Seal bytes are read once and hash-verified before parsing; original payload hashes and every private copy are checked before private helper execution.

Preparation binds source archive and tree, dependency manifests, installed bytes, runtime executables, guard bytes and config before/after/diff. It compares raw fences and exact ECMAScript TrimEnd expected representation to frozen source.
Runner and worker require checker status passed. Independent HTML checker findings and control qualification remain a separate scope.
limits: No target imports, guard invocation, build, render, checker call, product execution or cleanup/deadline experiment occurred. AST parsing and inert source/hash inspection only.

The superseded ce4d17 PREPARED_UNRUN seal does not bind this final implementation. Regenerate the packet and inspect the final seal, exact command, runtime identity and allocation before any invocation.
This report does not close the separate checker source review or authorise allocation, publication or real-site acceptance.
Thread scheduling, process creation, filesystem stalls and OS signal delivery are not hard real-time guarantees. The reserved cleanup interval and ownership algorithm have not been exercised.
SIGKILL or host loss cannot execute cleanup. Missing terminal receipts remain incomplete failures, never acceptance.
Dependency postchecks deliberately reject any copied-tree cache mutation. Actual compatibility and cost of copying, hashing and building within the deadline are unestablished.

Installed package version comparisons cover lock-addressed present packages; actual bytes are separately bound, without a new registry-integrity claim. Source identities bind content rather than runtime correctness.
